concerns.text: FR-001 (repo filtering), FR-002 (tagging), and FR-008 (matching) require specific logic for block extraction, refactoring detection (git mv), and repository exclusion (<5 blocks). Tasks T012 (extraction), T012b (git mv verification), and T016 (repo inclusion criteria) are marked incomplete/unchecked, leaving these critical functional requirements without implementing artifacts.

FR-007 mandates calculating classifier precision and recall on the ground truth subset. Task T017b is marked incomplete, meaning the artifact `data/ground_truth/classifier_metrics.json` required to verify SC-006 (threshold ≥ 0.85) will not be generated.

FR-004 requires calculating code churn and bug fix latency. Tasks T021 (latency calculation), T022 (churn calculation), T023 (null handling), T024 (repo deletion handling), and T025 (output saving) are all marked incomplete, leaving the longitudinal metric extraction (US2) unimplemented.

FR-005 (Wilcoxon tests, BH correction) and SC-001 (power analysis) require specific statistical outputs. Tasks T027 (Wilcoxon), T028 (BH correction), T029 (sensitivity), T030 (visualizations), T031 (power analysis), T032 (report summary), and T033 (artifacts) are marked incomplete, blocking verification of all statistical success criteria (SC-002 through SC-005).
